findings.claim: OpenTrack ships its own X-Plane plugin (shared memory based). Under X-Plane 12 on Linux, this plugin has reported reliability issues — freezing or failing to transmit data. Use the HeadTrack plugin with UDP output instead.
findings.evidence: opentrack/x-plane-plugin/README.md (Stand master, Commit ca03ee7 vom 2026-07-19): "The plugin is only compiled when the X-Plane SDK path is provided via the `SDK_XPLANE` CMake cache variable; with an empty path it is silently skipped." und "Both targets need `SDK_XPLANE` set. Without it, the output dropdown shows only non-X-Plane protocols." Bestaetigt durch x-plane-plugin/CMakeLists.txt: `set(SDK_XPLANE "" CACHE PATH ...)` / `if(SDK_XPLANE)`. Es wird also kein fertiges Plugin ausgeliefert. Zusaetzlich dokumentiert dieselbe README als Limitation: "No UDP fallback in the plugin. ... use opentrack's UDP over network output and a different plugin on the X-Plane side. This plugin is local-only."
findings.correction: OpenTrack has its own X-Plane output protocol with a companion plugin (`opentrack.xpl`, POSIX shared memory). It is not shipped as a binary — it is only built when the X-Plane SDK path is passed via `-DSDK_XPLANE=`, and it is local-only. Use the HeadTrack plugin with UDP output instead.

findings.claim: No additional system packages are required. There are no known Linux-specific issues.
findings.evidence: Das Linux-Binary aus dem offiziellen Release-ZIP (AutoGate-1.82.zip, `AutoGate/64/lin.xpl`) linkt dynamisch gegen OpenAL: `ldd` liefert `libopenal.so.1 => /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libopenal.so.1`. Passend dazu setzt `src/Makefile.lin64` `LIBS=-lopenal`. Auf Debian liefert `libopenal.so.1` das Paket `libopenal1` (packages.debian.org Contents-Suche, stable/amd64). Ohne dieses Paket laedt das Plugin nicht.
findings.correction: Extract the ZIP file to `Resources/plugins/`. The Linux binary links against OpenAL — install `libopenal1` if it is not already present. There are no further known Linux-specific issues.

findings.claim: There is no universal workaround. In some cases, `LD_PRELOAD` of the system libcurl in Steam launch options helps, but results vary by distribution.
findings.evidence: Die offizielle Doku (Requirements, Abschnitt Linux) nennt fuer Steam einen konkreten, dokumentierten Workaround: die inkompatible Bibliothek im Steam-Runtime-Verzeichnis mit Endung `.bak` umbenennen und stattdessen einen Symlink auf die System-Bibliothek setzen ("ln -s /usr/lib64/libcurl.so.4" in den Steam-Runtime-Ordner). LD_PRELOAD wird dort nicht als primaerer Weg beschrieben.
findings.correction: The documented workaround is to rename the libcurl shipped in the Steam runtime directory to `libcurl.so.4.bak` and create a symbolic link to the system library in its place. Details are in the [LiveTraffic documentation](https://twinfan.gitbook.io/livetraffic/introduction/requirements). The issue does not affect non-Steam X-Plane installations.

findings.claim: If the commercial SAM plugin is still installed, it should be removed (the `SAM_Library` can remain if needed by sceneries).
findings.evidence: README "Initial Installation" lists as mandatory steps: "2. Remove the AutoDGS plugin. It's functionality is included in openSAM." and "5. If installed remove the 'SAM Seasons emulator' plugin. Its functionality is included in openSAM." The page's installation section names only the SAM plugin, although it links AutoDGS as a separate page — a reader with AutoDGS installed will end up with a conflicting duplicate.
findings.correction: In `scenery_packs.ini`, `openSAM_Library` must be placed above `SAM_Library`. Before the first start, the AutoDGS plugin and a separately installed SAM Seasons emulator must be removed — both are part of openSAM now. If the commercial SAM plugin is still installed, it should be removed as well (the `SAM_Library` can remain if needed by sceneries).
